description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE December 9, 2015 Contact: Mike Trujillo mike [at] barraganforcongress [dot] com Mexican American Bar Association (MABA) endorses Nanette Barragán for Congress San Pedro, CA – Today, the nearly 1,000 member strong Mexican American Bar Association (MABA) endorsed Nanette Barragán in the Democratic Primary for California’s 44th Congressional District. The Mexican American Bar Association
title: Mexican American Bar Association (MABA) endorses Nanette Barragán for Congress - Nanette Barragan For Congress (CA-44)
